purpose: make the active LuHm/Oni worker set visible in chat without inventing hidden work
truthRules: Lum is always rendered as boss but is ACTIVE only when the current request is in a non-terminal phase
support workers appear only from an observed task envelope or verification receipt
completed workers may remain visible briefly as SUCCESS then become PARKED/hidden
no animation or badge may imply a worker is running when no observed activity packet exists
ERROR and UNKNOWN evidence may never be rendered as success
CROWN_STOP uses a crown/lock overlay and does not imply promotion

transport.preferred: event-driven snapshot from Lum host/runtime adapter

sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
